subject: general
question: Which of the following is used to measure the total output of goods and services in an economy including depreciation during a specific period within country?
solution:
The correct answer is **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** is the total market value of all **final goods and services** produced within a country in a specific period.
 
• GDP includes **depreciation**, which is the decrease in value of an asset over time.
 
• **Depreciation** is factored into GDP to account for the wear and tear on capital goods over the period.
 
• By including depreciation, GDP provides a comprehensive overview of the **economic activity** within a country, making it a crucial indicator for economists and policymakers.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Net Domestic Product (NDP)
 Calculated as GDP minus depreciation. It represents the net value of all goods and services after accounting for the loss in value of capital goods.
 
 

 2) Gross National Product (GNP)
 Measures the total value of goods and services produced by residents of a country, regardless of the production location. It includes incomes earned abroad.
 
 

 3) Net National Product (NNP)
 GNP minus depreciation. It represents the net output of a nation's economy, accounting for the wear and tear on capital goods.
